sarah_sales: FYI we're closing AcmeHealth (HIPAA). They want a commit recommendation + autoscale/fallback plan for a POC. Peak shape: ~1500 RPS for short bursts, steady 250 RPS. Can we sketch reserved GPU sizing + preheat and fallback?

mike_infra: Quick headcount: recommend sizing around steady+headroom. Rough calc below — sanity check please.

mike_infra: ```
assumptions:
  avg tokens per request = 40
  steady rps = 250 -> tokens/min = 250*40*60 = 600k
  peak rps = 1500 (short)
conclusion: reserve for steady with 30% headroom, allow burst pool to cover peaks.
```

julia_se: Agree on reserve-for-steady. My suggestion: reserve 6 GPUs (dedicated) with autoscale floor = 6, burst to 10 for 15-min windows. Preheat job to warm KV cache at T-10m.

sarah_sales: Is 6 -> 10 enough to keep p50/p95 under target? They want p95 < 400ms for short responses.

mike_infra: If we keep quantized/fast variant as fallback, 6->10 should hold p50; p95 depends on concurrency shape. Recommend canary the quantized model for non-critical traffic.

leo_reliability: Also call out AZ spread + eviction tolerance. If any reserved GPUs are in one AZ and that AZ has issues we need automatic fallback routing to another region or to the quantized variant. Add 20% headroom for AZ-failover runway.

eva_security: HIPAA checklist: need KMS integration + audit logs for all inference requests. Also confirm no customer data leaves VPC in Private deployment. I'll append answers to the questionnaire.

sarah_sales: Good — add a short runbook for ops: preheat window, KV warmup command, rollback to quantized model, and how to apply burst credits.

mike_infra: Draft runbook snippet: 
``
1) Preheat: run `redwood preheat --model acme-prod-v1 --duration 600 --concurrency 50` at T-10m
2) Monitor tokens/min and queue depth (alerts @oncall if queue_depth > 200)
3) If latency > 95th threshold -> enable quantized variant via routing policy
4) If AZ failure -> route traffic to fallback region + spin up extra 2 GPUs from burst pool
```

leo_reliability: Add: warm KV cache by replaying recent prompt set (stored in S3) during preheat. Also schedule a smoke test triggers at T-5m.

ops_bot: runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acmehealth-preheat (created by sarah_sales) :white_check_mark:

sarah_sales: I'll confirm pricing ask: customer prefers commit with burst credits. We'll propose monthly reserved 6 GPUs + 4 burst credits (auto-burst to 10). Also include 10% discount if they sign 12mo.

julia_se: One more technical ask for the proposal: include fallback latency budget and how much token throughput the quantized variant can handle (documented numbers). I'll attach performance bench to the deck.

eva_security: I'm on the questionnaire. Also request for SOC2/HIPAA attestations — legal will need timelines.

mike_infra: Action items: 1) finalize runbook (julia + leo) 2) bench quantized variant (julia) 3) security answers (eva) 4) pricing + draft contract (sarah)

sarah_sales: Thanks all — will loop in account exec tomorrow and set pre-POC kickoff. :thumbsup:
